overview: Explore chest or abdominal CT scans with NVIDIA NV-Reason-CT. Research and education only — not for real diagnosis, treatment, or clinical decisions. Upload a .nii or .nii.gz volume in Chat and review the experimental report alongside a local CT preview.

intent.problem: Explore experimental 3D CT model output with inspectable source volumes.

safety.reason: Not for real diagnosis or treatment.

product.benefit: Compare experimental model output with a preview of the uploaded volume.
product.input: Upload a de-identified .nii or .nii.gz CT and select chest or abdomen.
product.output: Experimental report with model revision, input hash, anatomy, and limitations.
product.how_it_works: Runs blueprint-owned NV-Reason-CT in Docker on an NVIDIA GPU with at least 48 GB memory.
runtime_features: NVIDIA GPU with 48 GB memory required
